title: edritria supina
intro: Edritria supina, commonly known as Erigeron supinus or Supine Fleabane, is a flowering plant belonging to the daisy family. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Edritria supina include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it effective in soothing irritated skin and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
